guardNodeModulesLink.why: refusal by design in a junctioned worktree; no npm install/ci/prune or lifecycle is run in this lane (npm_config_dry_run=true exported)

behavior: The first append to any stream in the journal installs that stream's genesis event_history_branches row and its effective head in the SAME transaction as the append, idempotently; nothing else about the append changes. The match mirror's global backfill stays (U24 removes it) and finds the rows already present.

seamsAsRead.what: appendWithExtension: schema parse + command identity outside, then ONE db.transaction(...).immediate() running the caller extend around appendInTransaction
appendPreparedWithExtension: prepare + parse + extend(append) inside ONE immediate transaction (the match mirror and campaign accept-contract path use it)

appendInTransaction: receipt replay/conflict, head read for (stream, expectedBranchId) at 184-190, revision-conflict return at 191-198 BEFORE any write, verifyHead, high-water allocation, insertReceipt, insertEvent, advanceHead at 263. No write to event_history_* anywhere.
isSeededCandidateHead: probes sqlite_master for event_history_branches and returns false when absent (precedent: a database that never grew the branch tables keeps working)
advanceHead: INSERT/ON CONFLICT UPDATE of event_journal_stream_heads guarded by the expected revision+digest
backfillGenesisBranches: global EVENT_HISTORY_GENESIS_BACKFILL_SQL in its own (nestable) transaction; returns the count of effective heads added

EVENT_HISTORY_GENESIS_BACKFILL_SQL: per journal head with no branch row for its stream, a root-shaped branch (depth 0, parent NULL, base 0, base event NULL, genesis digest, status effective, created_by 'migration') on head.branch_id, and an effective head whose generation is COALESCE(match_authority_baseline.effective_generation, 1); both NOT EXISTS-guarded (read-only; outside ownership)
migration 31 triggers: a root branch must carry the genesis digest; an effective head must name an effective branch (read-only)
readEffectiveStreamHead answers MISSING_HEAD (root, 0, genesis digest) whenever the stream has no effective head row - which is every campaign stream today

mirrorMatchBatchToJournal: appendPreparedWithExtension on branch effective?.branchId ?? 'main', then branches.backfillGenesisBranches() at :264 inside the extend after a committed append (the only non-test caller of the backfill; read-only, U24 removes it)
MATCH_BASELINE_BRANCH_ID = 'main': a match stream's first append lands on 'main', not 'root', so the genesis branch id must be the appended branch (as the backfill uses head.branch_id)
appendCampaignCommandBatch -> journal.append(batch): campaign streams append through the same writer (read-only)
awaitGenesisBranch only reads the genesis marker; nothing in the campaign path writes event_history_branches (read-only)
assertGenesisBranchRecovers: exactly one branch row, status effective, ancestor_depth 0, parent_branch_id null (read-only)
suites run the writer on a database with ONLY the event-journal migration (v8): the install must not assume the branch tables exist

design: SQLiteEventHistoryBranchStore gains installGenesisBranch(stream, branchId, installedAt): the per-stream form of the backfill - one root-shaped effective branch row on the given branch id and one effective head whose generation is read exactly as the backfill reads it (match_authority_baseline, else 1). It opens no transaction of its own; it runs on the caller's. NOT EXISTS-guarded on the stream's branch rows, and the head is inserted only when the branch row was.

SQLiteEventJournalWriter.appendInTransaction calls it, inside the append's own transaction and after the revision/identity checks, only when the append is the stream's first: no journal head for (stream, branch) AND no journal head for the stream on any branch AND the branch tables exist (the existing sqlite_master probe, extracted to one helper and reused by isSeededCandidateHead).

Genesis branch id = the appended branch (root for campaign streams, 'main' for mirrored match streams), exactly as the backfill's head.branch_id; created_by 'event-journal'; installed/created at the batch's recordedAt.

A refused append (revision conflict, identity conflict) returns before the install; a thrown append or extension rolls the install back with the batch; two first appends serialize on the IMMEDIATE transaction, the loser sees a head and is refused with revision-conflict exactly as today, and the NOT EXISTS guard plus the partial unique index keep one genesis row.
The mirror backfill call stays; it finds the stream already installed and inserts nothing for it.
risksForTheParent: U19 turns on campaign launch gating for journaled co-op campaigns: once a campaign stream has an effective head, launch-head resolution can answer it; the parent's main proof runs verify:qc:coop-campaign-journey.
Review classes authority + replay need the owner's head-bound Lane B ruling.

Every stream type gets a genesis row on first append (campaign, match, campaign replica, test streams): suites outside src/lib/events/journal that raw-insert a root genesis row AFTER appending to the same stream would now collide; the local stage runs the campaign and multiplayer-server suites and reports any such collision rather than editing outside ownership.

Pre-existing streams that already hold journal heads but no branch row are NOT installed by this unit (not a first append); the mirror backfill still covers match streams while combat mode is on (U24 owns its removal).
